Name: Full Name (Customer Detail)
High Ticket Orders
Expression:
CALCULATE(
    [Total Orders],
    FILTER(
        'Product Lookup',
        'Product Lookup'[ProductPrice] > [Overall Retail Price]
    )
)

Name: 10-Day Rolling Revenue
Expression:
CALCULATE(
    [Total Revenue],
    DATESINPERIOD(
        'Calendar Lookup'[Date],
        MAX(
            'Calendar Lookup'[Date]),
            -10,
            DAY)
)

Name: 90-Day Rolling Profit
Expression:
CALCULATE(
    [Total Profit],
    DATESINPERIOD(
        'Calendar Lookup'[Date],
        MAX(
            'Calendar Lookup'[Date]),
            -90,
            DAY
    )
)

Name: Dynamic Line Color
Expression:
SWITCH(
SELECTEDVALUE('Product Metric Selection'[Product Metric Selection Order]),
0, "#333333", // Orders
1, "#333333", // Revenue
2, "#333333", // Profit
3, "#E53E3E", // Returns (Highlights in Red)
4, "#E53E3E", // Return %
"#808080" // Fallback Gray
)

Name: Customer Metric Color
Expression:
SWITCH(
    SELECTEDVALUE(
        'Customer Metric Selection'[Customer Metric Selection Order]
    ),
    0, "#2F2F2F",
    1, "#19D3D3",
    "#2F2F2F"
)
